snippet.title: Bases Loaded 3 (NES) Gameplay 240p | No Commentary - Jaleco, Sept 1991 (Original Hardware)
snippet.description:
Bases Loaded 3 was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in September 1991. All audio/visual elements copyright 1991, Jaleco. Music composed by ?

https://nesguide.com/games/bases-loaded-3/

This video was produced for NESguide.com - a website that attempts to organize the NES catalog and make it easy to explore. Gameplays from this channel are featured throughout the NESguide website to showcase the original basic mechanics and audio/visual design of each title. Thank you for your continued support of this project, since 2007!


ABOUT BASES LOADED 3 (NES)

While Jaleco did hire famed baseball player Ryne Sandberg for an endorsement, this installment of the game did not feature real teams or players. More unpopular with players, however, was the somewhat bizarre premise that "playing a perfect game", not winning a pennant, was the game's ultimate goal. Regardless, there would be one more NES Bases Loaded title, as well as several Super NES titles.

AKA: Shin Moero!! Pro Yakyuu
